title: OLEANDER Digital Product / Human-Centred Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic human-centred digital-product development from authority and context-of-use through human-centred requirements, competing concepts, detailed interaction solutions, representative evaluation, implementation readback and in-use lifecycle review without substituting UI polish, analytics, software completion or adjacent specialist approvals for HCD evidence.
scope_in: interactive-system context of use and affected-person evidence
information architecture, interaction, content and workflow design
accessibility and inclusive-design interfaces within appointment scope
in-use support, failure, analytics and lifecycle HCD review
scope_out: automatic software architecture or engineering approval
automatic privacy, security, safety, legal or regulatory approval
automatic accessibility conformance from automated checks
automatic human evidence from AI-simulated users
automatic Design KEEP, Integration PASS or Project Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, product/project authority and applicable privacy, security, accessibility, safety and regulatory owners.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional human-centred judgment about an interactive system, digital product, task/workflow, information/interaction structure, accessibility, representative evaluation or in-use experience outcome.
responsibility_triggers: interactive behaviour materially affects people or downstream product decisions
usability, accessibility or human-centred quality is claimed
AI or automation behaviour requires human oversight or interaction design
representative user evidence is needed to close a consequential claim
production behaviour or field use may contradict reviewed design assumptions
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid boundary across appointment scope, context evidence, task/claim-scoped knowledge mounts, representative evaluation, production readback, interface maturity, reviewer authorization and specialist/regulatory authority governs the specific HCD claim.
not_triggered_when: purely decorative visual output with explicit exclusion of interactive human-centred claims
software-only implementation work that introduces no HCD or user-experience claim
mandatory_reopen_triggers: material user or stakeholder population change
accessibility, privacy, security, safety or regulatory change affecting use
production support, failure or analytics evidence contradicting assumptions
AI/model behaviour drift affecting human interaction
applicable authority or evidence source change

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential HCD, usability, accessibility, human-factors, service, product, analytics and platform evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a professional HCD decision.
required_methods: ISO 9241-210 human-centred design activities and principles
representative research/evaluation methods appropriate to the claim
theory_routes: service and socio-technical interaction where applicable
source_routes: applicable accessibility, privacy, security, safety and domain sources
precedent_case_routes: bounded digital-product precedents with explicit context and transfer limits
practice_routes: Service Blueprinting where service interfaces are coupled
Human Factors Validation where population/task/risk context applies

stages.professional_question: What interactive system and human-centred claims are in scope, for whom, under whose authority and evidence boundary?
entry_conditions: HCD trigger is material or applicability is being resolved
knowledge_inputs: current HCD process and applicable regulatory/accessibility sources
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Task/claim-scoped Operational Mount is required for consequential authority, accessibility, safety, privacy or domain claims.
human_experience_consequences: affected-person groups and excluded populations become explicit
design_language_consequences: none may be frozen before the HCD problem and context are bounded
technical_consequences: research/data/access constraints and implementation dependencies are identified
content_projection_requirements: state scope, exclusions, affected groups and does-not-prove boundaries
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review is required before Current process adoption and whenever project/claim policy triggers it.
exit_conditions: scope, affected people, authority and claim boundary are explicit enough to begin context work

stages.professional_question: Who uses or is affected by the system, for what goals/tasks and under which physical, social, technical and organizational conditions?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mounted methods/sources may structure research but cannot substitute for current-context evidence.
human_experience_consequences: real task, environment, capability and interruption conditions become explicit
design_language_consequences: later interaction/content language must respond to observed context rather than assumed personas
technical_consequences: device/channel/assistive-technology and system constraints are exposed
content_projection_requirements: separate observation, interpretation, uncertainty and unrepresented populations
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required where consequential context claims affect adoption, safety, accessibility or other governed decisions.
exit_conditions: material context claims are evidence-bound and gaps are explicit

stages.professional_question: What human-centred outcomes and interaction requirements must the solution satisfy in the declared contexts?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential target/criterion sources require current task/claim-scoped Operational Eligibility.
human_experience_consequences: effectiveness, effort, comprehension, accessibility, control and recovery are made testable where applicable
design_language_consequences: later interaction/content choices inherit explicit human-centred requirements
technical_consequences: evaluation measures and implementation-dependent assumptions become traceable
content_projection_requirements: distinguish human-centred, business, technical and regulatory requirements
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adoption-relevant human-centred requirement claims when triggered.
exit_conditions: consequential HCD requirements are traceable to context/evidence and have evaluation routes
reopen_triggers: context, product-policy, authority or specialist-requirement changes

stages.professional_question: Which fundamentally different interaction/information/service-touchpoint concept best resolves current HCD requirements and constraints?
entry_conditions: HCD requirements are sufficiently defined for option generation
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Precedent/pattern knowledge is bounded support and cannot substitute for current option testing.
human_experience_consequences: task flow, findability, control, errors and cross-channel experience are shaped
design_language_consequences: interaction and information hierarchy mechanisms are established before cosmetic polish
technical_consequences: architecture/data/platform dependencies of concepts are exposed
content_projection_requirements: show real mechanism alternatives and rejected-option rationale
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent concept review required where project policy or consequential claim requires it.
exit_conditions: selected concept has evidence/rationale against material alternatives and open risks are explicit
reopen_triggers: requirements, technical feasibility or evaluation evidence invalidates concept basis

stages.professional_question: Is the selected HCD mechanism resolved across meaningful states, content, accessibility and implementation interfaces?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Current platform/accessibility claims require applicable source and Operational Eligibility checks.
human_experience_consequences: material states, recovery, permissions, accessibility and feedback become explicit
design_language_consequences: visual/interaction language is connected to hierarchy, behaviour and human-centred intent
technical_consequences: implementation-state and instrumentation requirements become inspectable
content_projection_requirements: represent non-happy-path, degraded and accessibility states, not only hero screens
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent professional review required before candidate process/adoption claims and when project policy triggers it.
exit_conditions: material solution states are specified enough for representative prototype/evaluation and implementation coordination

stages.professional_question: What must be made interactive or simulated to expose material human-use uncertainty before downstream commitment?
entry_conditions: material uncertainty requires representative interaction or experiment
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Prototype method and test criteria require bounded evidence appropriate to the question.
human_experience_consequences: uncertain human interaction is exposed before false certainty propagates
design_language_consequences: tested behaviour and content hierarchy can revise detailed design language
technical_consequences: fake/live data, fidelity and technical simulation boundaries are recorded
content_projection_requirements: show exact prototype revision, task coverage and limitations
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review required when prototype evidence supports a consequential governed claim.
exit_conditions: question-bound uncertainty has an evidence-bound disposition or remains explicit BLOCK/HOLD
reopen_triggers: prototype revision, task/context/population or implementation changes

stages.professional_question: Does the current solution satisfy declared HCD requirements for representative people, tasks and contexts within the evidence ceiling?
entry_conditions: evaluation question and current solution revision are defined
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential evaluation methods/criteria and external standards require current task/claim-scoped Operational Eligibility.
human_experience_consequences: actual task success/failure, comprehension, effort and barriers are read back within scope
design_language_consequences: evidence may reopen interaction/content/visual mechanism rather than only surface styling
technical_consequences: evaluation environment, instrumentation and production/prototype differences are explicit
content_projection_requirements: preserve failed cases, subgroup harms, denominator and uncertainty
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review required before EV4/Current adoption; specialist independent review remains separate where triggered.
open_items_allowed: non-critical untested edge contexts within declared ceiling
exit_conditions: critical HCD requirements have evidence-bound dispositions and material failures are repaired/retested or explicitly block the claim
reopen_triggers: solution revision, population/context, method, requirement or implementation changes

stages.professional_question: Has implementation preserved the HCD mechanism and requirements that were actually reviewed?
entry_conditions: implementation exists or handoff is materially underway
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Platform/tool evidence supports implementation checks but cannot substitute for actual build readback.
human_experience_consequences: implemented behaviour is checked against reviewed interaction rather than screenshot similarity
design_language_consequences: component/visual behaviour changes are tied back to HCD mechanism and requirements
technical_consequences: actual build states, event definitions and known deviations become source-bound
content_projection_requirements: record implementation differences and affected claims explicitly
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required when implementation readback is consumed for a consequential professional close/adoption decision.
open_items_allowed: known non-critical deviations inside claim ceiling
exit_conditions: material behaviour deviations are resolved, accepted by the right authority, or explicitly block the HCD claim
reopen_triggers: implementation, content, platform, accessibility or production-behaviour changes

stages.professional_question: What does actual use reveal about current HCD assumptions, and which product conclusion must reopen now?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Reusable interpretation requires bounded evidence and does not bypass G9/Knowledge validation.
human_experience_consequences: actual barriers, failures, recovery and changed contexts feed the product without being universalized
design_language_consequences: actual-use evidence may reopen interaction/content/visual rules
technical_consequences: configuration and instrumentation changes are separated from HCD causality claims
content_projection_requirements: separate observed outcome, causal hypothesis, uncertainty, counterevidence and transfer boundary
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review required when in-use evidence supports consequential professional, safety, accessibility or adoption claims.
exit_conditions: material product-specific failures are reopened/resolved and reusable lessons remain bounded candidates
reopen_triggers: new production evidence, population/context or configuration changes

controlling_authority_requirements: adjacent domain owners retain technical/legal/statutory authority
HCD cannot self-accept another domain's interface
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Synchronize by required interface information and maturity, never by matching stage numbers or sprint labels.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: non-critical interface remains explicitly OPEN inside current claim ceiling
integration_readback_requirements: reopen HCD claims when a consumed interface materially changes

native_source_of_truth_rules: native editable design/research/test source controls over screenshots/exports
production behaviour requires actual build/readback identity
participant/evaluation evidence retains provenance and privacy boundary
execution_owner_requirements: specialist accessibility/safety/privacy/security work remains with qualified owner where triggered
tool_adapter_requirements: analytics/prototype automation cannot manufacture human evidence

assurance.professional_review: Digital Product / HCD owner reviews domain-native HCD evidence and outputs within appointment scope.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence/truth review remains separate and must preserve population, context, method, denominator, uncertainty and provenance.
assurance.independent_review: Independent Professional Domain review binds the exact reviewed input under Current §34; another model/tool/session is not independence.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional completion requires owner-native receipt/readback; machine/schema/CI success cannot award the professional verdict.

stale_scope_rules: stale only affected HCD claim/evidence/review relations
unrelated chronology does not globally stale the process
upstream_impact_rules: changed authority/claim boundary can reopen dependent stages
downstream_impact_rules: changed requirement/concept/solution can stale affected prototype/evaluation/implementation evidence
interface_reopen_rules: material R-F interface change reopens only HCD consumers of that interface
receipt_stale_rules: historical receipts remain immutable under consumed authority/configuration
current consumption requires re-resolution when relevant fingerprint/interface/review input changes

process_exit_conditions: context evidence adequate for claimed scope
representative evaluation resolves critical HCD claims
implementation readback closes material behaviour deviations
critical interfaces have required R-F disposition
open_items_allowed: bounded non-critical items inside explicit claim ceiling
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Owner-native Digital Product / HCD professional receipt bound to exact process/configuration/evidence/review input.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Professional process completion does not itself adopt this reusable process, grant Project Promotion, or mutate Current architecture authority.
completion_contract.claim_ceiling: Only the exact HCD scope/populations/contexts/product revision/evidence and interface boundary actually read back.
